title.zh: CoinShares: Digital Asset Investment Products See $3.55B in Weekly Inflows, Larg
title.en: CoinShares: Digital Asset Investment Products See $3.55B in Weekly Inflows, Larg

current_state.zh: CoinShares reported that global digital asset investment products recorded roughly $3.55 billion in net inflows last week — the largest weekly total of the year — with Bitcoin contributing $2.52 billion, Ethereum $702 million, Solana $193 million and XRP $92.3 million, as total AUM rose to about $173 billion.
